$comment: Single source of (os, arch) truth for the release workflows. Read at job start via jq and consumed as a matrix include via fromJSON. Adding a new target = adding one entry here; release-server.yml + release-desktop.yml pick it up automatically (server matrix is linux-only by definition). The desktop is the Tauri app under desktop/desktop-app, built via tauri-apps/tauri-action. `rust_target` is the host triple `tauri build` targets; `artifact_exts` lists the bundle extensions the collect step gathers for that leg and renames to the versionless soma-desktop-<os>-<arch>.<ext> the docs landing page links to (macos `zip` is produced by zipping the bundled .app).
